verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a built-in scheduler, Automations, which persists jobs, wakes the agent at the scheduled time, and delivers output to a chat channel, a webhook, or nowhere. It is complemented by webhook and Gmail PubSub triggers and standing orders for autonomous programs. A community user independently reports scheduling tasks across multiple agents. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of recurrence syntax and job management (e.g., cron expressions, editing and listing jobs).
